entities.name: Marie-Édouard Mununu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie-Édouard Mununu-Kasiala was a Congolese Roman Catholic prelate and Trappist monk. Prior of the Notre Dame of Emmanual Monastery of Kasanza in 1975, he was auxiliary bishop of Roman Catholic Diocese of Kikwit from 1985 to 1986 and subsequently bishop of Kikwit from 1986 to 2016.

Prior of the Notre Dame of Emmanual Monastery of Kasanza in 1975, he was auxiliary bishop of Roman Catholic Diocese of Kikwit from 1985 to 1986 and subsequently bishop of Kikwit from 1986 to 2016.
